learning.flow: persist CAS queue order and explicit revealed current item; deliberate right removes, wrong appends; request-id repetition is idempotent; reload resumes exact queue; only authorized published items. Completion is self-assessed learning feedback, not server-graded test proof.

test.retake: balanced 10 distinct authorized items, disjoint from immediately preceding completed 10; insufficient permitted pool yields truthful localized scope/content state while allowed learning remains usable
test.authority: server private keys, current immutable definition/version, account/run binding, CAS + idempotency and rechecked commercial rights/publication on start/save/grade

authoring: Source inventory is content evidence only. No active seed or publication before editorial coverage/ID preservation and imported local male Qwen audio + word timings for every audible German task. Original source family scope/level remains honest; copied Akkusativ HTMLs are one family.
